text.text:
:wave: *Hello! I'm Claude, an AI assistant created by Anthropic.*

I'm here to help with your questions and tasks. Just mention me using @Claude to get started!

*How I collect and process context:*
• When you mention me in a thread, I automatically read recent messages in that thread to understand the conversation context
• I can access and analyze files shared in the conversation when you mention me
• I only process messages in threads where I'm explicitly mentioned
• Your conversations are private and only accessible to you through your connected account
• I do not retain or train on your Slack conversations

elements.text: :bulb: To work with me here, each person connects their own account once. <https://example.com/app_redirect?team=T0TESTWS0&app=A0TESTCLA0&tab=home|Open Claude's Home tab> to connect yours.
